text:
Cheng: Heads up — onboarding new tenant 'sable' into ap-southeast-6. Need p5 / p4d / g5 quota increases plus ENI limits for multi-AZ fleet. Account: 987654321098. Any immediate blockers?

Maria: Quick context — workload is mix of throughput (batch) and latency-critical inference. We expect ~30 p5 nodes day1, burst to ~60 within 2 months. Need ENI and subnet capacity checked for pinned IP allocations.

Raj: Copy. Which AZs/subnets will they use? Also confirm VPC has enough free /25s for CUDA nodes (we attach multiple ENIs per instance).

Cheng: Subnets are: subnet-0aa1bb2c (ap-southeast-6a), subnet-1cc2dd3e (ap-southeast-6b), subnet-2ee3ff4g (ap-southeast-6c). VPC cidr 10.40.0.0/16. We'll be using secondary IPs per ENI for pod networking.

Sara: I can kick off the Service Quotas and support case. Will request increases for these quotas:
- EC2 p5.48xlarge (p5) On-Demand limit
- EC2 p4d.24xlarge (p4d) On-Demand limit
- G5 limits (g5.48x / g5g variants)
- Network Interfaces per Region & ENIs per EC2 instance
- Elastic IP and VPC route table limits (if NATs will be used)

Raj: Also need to bump ENI per instance quota for the account if not already raised. On AWS some instance types consume more ENIs — check `describe-instances` and `describe-subnets` before approving.

Cheng: Agree. I've attached the minimal test fleet plan in S3: s3://redwood-inference/onboard/sable/ap-se6/fleet-plan.md (internal). Please include a safety bump: request ~20% headroom over projected 60 nodes.

quota-bot: Created AWS support case AWS-CASE-876543210 and Service Quotas request SQR-2026-04-9876. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?displayId=AWS-CASE-876543210

Sara: Filing the formal quota requests now. Suggested text for Service Quotas CLI:```bash
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase \
  --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1234ABCD \
  --desired-value 70 --region ap-southeast-6
```
Replace L-1234ABCD with the specific quota codes for p5/p4d/g5 instance family sizes.

Devin: FYI on cost — at steady-state 60 p5 nodes (reserve short-term burst with on-demand) estimated spend ~ $1.2M/mo. Recommend negotiating reserved capacity if they plan sustained usage.

Raj: Heads-up: networking team flagged that NAT gateway IP egress could hit limits if start-up traffic is concentrated. Consider VPC egress scaling or shared NATs across AZs.

Maria: Can someone confirm we have IAM roles and instance profiles pre-approved for the tenant? That can slow provisioning if we need org-level approval.

Cheng: IAM roles are templated; will submit PR to infra-templates and link here. Also, please validate that the ENI quotas are per AZ vs per Region for this account.

Sara: AWS case assigned to engineer; ETA 48-72 hours for quota increases but could be longer for p5/p4d. If AWS asks for justification, use: "Production inference fleet for Redwood Inference customer tenant; performance-sensitive workload; multi-AZ redundancy required."

Devin: Marking cost review follow-up. I'll open a ticket to discuss committed spend options with finance and sales.

Maria: Once quotas are in place, I'll run a small canary (3 p5 nodes) and validate NVLINK / driver stack + ENI attachments.

Cheng: Thanks — please paste support case updates here. If AWS requests AZ consolidation as a workaround, we should push back — multi-AZ is required for SLA. :pray:

quota-bot: Support case update: "Engineer requested additional justification; next response due in 24 hours."

Sara: Noted. I'll add a short architecture diagram and SLA note to the case.

Raj: If we hit quota delays, fallback plan is to provision g5 nodes in neighboring region (ap-southeast-5) and cross-region route traffic via gwlb for tests. That requires extra latency validation.

Cheng: OK — keep that as fallback. Thanks all.
